title: Take the daemon's pillar-free host runtime off the serial tail of the cold core build
goal: Shorten the serial critical path of the cold `cargo build -p susi` on Linux x86_64 toward the 60 s budget without removing capability: move the susi-daemon modules that reference no GAWD, GEMI, GMCP, harness, server or tools crate into a new crate, susi-daemon-runtime, that compiles beside the pillar crates; susi-daemon re-exports every module under its old path.
limitations: The whole-build wall difference is inside this host's load noise (other agents compiling; load 3 to 17 across the six runs), so it is not claimed; only the measured tail segment (daemon start to binary done) is, at about 1.2 to 1.5 s per pair.
The Windows-only paths in supervisor.rs (cfg(windows), winapi facade) moved unchanged with the winapi target dependency, but were not compiled on this Linux host.

Source-reading verification tests (vc_202_010_mastery, core_boot_starts_nothing, core_never_downloads_models_unasked, brain_scout_schedule) now read the moved files at their new paths; vc_202_010_mastery scans both crates so its no-bare-thread-spawn guard still covers the moved code.
The full root integration suite (100+ binaries) was not run; the integration tests that name moved modules were.

provenance.agent: corecut (Cursor subagent, CachyOS Linux x86_64, CEO laptop)

results.change: 26 susi-daemon modules (supervisor, service_supervision, watchdog, engine_watchdog, nat, tls, port_fallback, resource_governor, security, os_provision, scheduled_missions, blackboard, sla_monitor, swarm_metrics, telemetry, boot_trace, context_adapters, orchestrator, hot_reload_coverage, eco_drift_alerts, eco_probe_scheduler and the five zc_* startup checks; 8,737 lines) moved unchanged (git mv) into crates/susi-daemon-runtime; susi-daemon re-exports each under the same path, so no caller changed. The daemon drops five dependencies only those modules used (dashmap, sha1, tokio-rustls, rcgen, susi-http-transport). No capability, port or command removed; no pillar crate gains a dependency, so the lean-core reach ceilings do not move.
results.selection: A module moves only if neither it nor any daemon module it references names a pillar or service crate (transitive closure over crate:: paths); service_control stays because it calls SusiDaemon. Per-item rustc self-profile of susi-daemon (non-incremental): the moved modules carried 1.26 s of the daemon's 3.95 s type-check, borrow-check and MIR time.
results.measurement_method: Alternated fully cold `cargo build -p susi --offline --locked --timings` into empty target directories, base worktree at ed9710c17 then this change, three pairs back to back on the same host; load average and running rustc count recorded before each run (28 threads).
